identity.name: HEMELEY
identity.vibe: Spicy, Street, Urgent, Local, Warm, Unapologetic
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Street stall aesthetics x Fintech speed
Content is King: Big, juicy photos, clear prices
Zoom In: Focus on the food texture
Contrast: High contrast for outdoor visibility (sunlight)

headings.usage: Page titles, Menu names, Big CTAs

usage_rules: Use Primary Orange for the main 'HEMELEY' CTA button.
Use Secondary Red for urgent tags (e.g., 'Only 2 left').
Background should be Cassava White to avoid clinical sterility.
Text should never be pure black (#000000). Use Charcoal (#2D241E).

layout.spacing_system: Generous padding (p-4, p-6) even on mobile to let food photos breathe.
layout.grid_strategy: Mobile-first single column. Tablet/Desktop: Masonry/Bento grid.
layout.container_width: max-w-md mx-auto for mobile view simulation on desktop, or full width responsive.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full font-heading text-xl tracking-wide shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-primary text-primary rounded-full font-heading text-lg hover:bg-primary/10

cards.menu_item: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-stone-100 overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative group hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.vendor_stat: bg-white rounded-xl p-4 border border-stone-100 shadow-sm flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center

inputs.style: bg-white border-2 border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 transition-colors font-body text-lg placeholder:text-stone-400

navigation.bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-stone-200 p-4 flex justify-around items-center z-40 safe-area-bottom

visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for cards, rounded-full for buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background if possible, or just solid warm white.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down on click. Images zoom slightly on hover.

general: Ensure the app is mobile-first. Test on mobile view.
NO LOGIN for customers. This is critical.
Use 'shadcn/ui' components but override styles to match the 'Spicy Street' theme.

specific_pages.home: Zone selector must be big and tappable. Menu list should load instantly.
specific_pages.menu_detail: Hero image should be large. 'HEMELEY' button fixed at bottom.
specific_pages.order_modal: Simple form. Pseudonym, Comment, Phone. Payment instructions clear.
specific_pages.vendor_dashboard: Simple auth. Big buttons for 'Add Menu' and 'Toggle Availability'.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for the background. Use solid warm white.
Do not center align everything. Use left align for text, center for big headings if needed.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
Ensure high contrast for outdoor usage.
